title: Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness: How Context and Skills Shape Self-Evolving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.28244v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autoresearch agents, which autonomously design, run, and refine experiments, are accelerating scientific progress, particularly in AI research. However, existing agents rely on harnesses that combine multiple mechanisms, making it difficult to determine how individual components contribute to performance. We systematically study harness design for long-horizon, self-evolving autoresearch agents along two dimensions: context management, which determines what an agent retains from its past attempts, and skill management, which governs how it stores and reuses lessons from those attempts. translated_title: 揭秘自动研究框架：上下文与技能如何塑造自我进化智能体
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.28244v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：自动研究智能体能够自主设计、运行和改进实验，正在加速科学进步，尤其是在AI研究领域。然而，现有的智能体依赖于组合了多种机制的框架，这使得难以确定各个组件对性能的具体贡献。我们从两个维度系统性地研究了面向长时程、自我进化自动研究智能体的框架设计：一是上下文管理，决定智能体从过去的尝试中保留哪些信息；二是技能管理，控制它如何存储和复用从这些尝试中吸取的经验教训。在MLE-Bench和KernelBench上使用gpt-oss-120b、gpt-6-luna和gpt-6-sol，我们通过在一个共享的智能体框架内将每项设计选择与近期截断基线进行对比评估，从而隔离出单个框架设计选择的影响。对于上下文管理，我们发现保留过去尝试的独立可访问记录比维护……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次系统性地解构了自动研究智能体的框架设计，通过在共享框架内对上下文管理和技能管理两个维度的各项设计选择进行隔离评估，揭示了何种信息保留与经验复用机制最能有效提升自我进化智能体在MLE-Bench和KernelBench上的长时程研究表现。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically dissects the harness design of self-evolving autoresearch agents by isolating the effects of individual context-management and skill-management choices within a shared framework across MLE-Bench and KernelBench, revealing which mechanisms for retaining past attempts and reusing lessons most effectively drive long-horizon performance.
